subject: gstack
tagline: Opinionated software factory of slash-command specialists (CEO, eng, design, QA, ship) plus a persistent browser daemon.

capabilities.name: Generated skill suite
capabilities.description: Each top-level folder is a SKILL.md generated from templates with shared preamble.

capabilities.name: Office-hours to ship spine
capabilities.description: office-hours → spec → autoplan → implement → review → QA → ship.

capabilities.name: Sequential specialist pipeline
capabilities.description: CEO → Design → Eng → DX must run in order; dual-voice Claude+Codex per phase.

capabilities.name: Host adapters
capabilities.description: One skill source rewritten per host (Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, …).

capabilities.name: Persistent browser daemon
capabilities.description: Long-lived Chromium over localhost HTTP; ~100–200ms after first start.

plugins.mechanism: host-generated skill install, not a native plugin runtime

unique_selling_points: Markdown is the program; browser is the hard part

limitations.description: Generated SKILL.md preamble is large (opposite of Superpowers tiny bootstrap)
No org-chart, hire, or cost budgets
